payload.summary: On Call identifier guard covers only logistics and contacts, and it is not established whether it blocks or only warns
payload.detail: src/lib/on-call/free-text-guard.ts adminFreeTextProblem returns null for every section except logistics and contacts, and wraps identifierShapeWarning. Whether the other four sections have another validator, and whether a warning prevents persistence or transmission, is unestablished. Next action: one parameterised test with unique PII canaries in each of the six sections asserting rejected/redacted/persisted/logged/transmitted.
